title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning: each side's best configuration on training seeds 5 to 9
description: More training seeds for the two configurations compared head to head, both in expliCCit's encoder-decoder architecture (an encoder of 1.27 million weights with seven outputs, read by an actor and a critic of two layers of 256): the meaningful side's best, the actor on neto1 v1's seven LCF estimates cloned from BBRv3's logged window multipliers (lcft-paper-none, 10,000 updates, as in exp-lcf-cost-teacher-317), and the free side's best, seven free latents trained by the critic with TD3+BC on log utility (lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k, alpha 2.5, 150,000 updates, 10-step returns, as in exp-lcf-cost-td3-326). Each side's configuration was chosen on links 0 to 99 by the mean over seeds 0 and 1 (exp-lcf-cost-teacher-search-318, exp-lcf-cost-td3-search-327); seeds 0 to 4 are in those runs and exp-lcf-cost-teacher-seeds-321 and exp-lcf-cost-td3-seeds-328. On five seeds the gap between them held across links but not firmly across seeds (Mann-Whitney p 0.10 to 0.22, exp-lcf-cost-td3-report-329); seeds 5 to 9 double the seeds for the report run that scores both on the same links. summary.md lists each policy's training diagnostics.
run: N="$IN/n/$(cat "$IN/n/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; case "$SIDE" in meaningful) O="$OUT/lcft-paper-none-s$SEED"; NET2='{"algo": "bc", "action": "multiplier", "reward": "sage", "reward_alignment": "same", "action_max": 1.0, "action_decimals": 3, "steps": 10000}'; CTL='["bbr3"]';; free) O="$OUT/lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k-s$SEED"; NET2='{"algo": "td3bc", "action": "multiplier", "reward": "log_utility", "reward_scale": 1.0, "n_step": 10, "action_max": 1.0, "action_decimals": 3, "alpha": 2.5, "steps": 150000, "inputs": "raw", "encoder": "free"}'; CTL=null;; *) exit 1;; esac; mkdir -p "$O"; jq -n --arg d "$IN/d" --arg n "$N" --argjson seed "$SEED" --argjson net2 "$NET2" --argjson ctl "$CTL" '{data: [$d], split_by: "link", seed: $seed, net1_from: $n, net2: $net2} + (if $ctl == null then {} else {controllers: $ctl} end)' > "$O/train.json"; uv run expliccit train run "$O/train.json" "$O"; rm -f "$O/net1.pt"
collect: { echo "| policy | transitions | validation BC error | seconds | final diagnostics |"; echo "|---|---|---|---|---|"; for r in "$OUT"/lcft*/report.json; do echo "| $(basename "$(dirname "$r")") | $(jq -r '[.net2.transitions, .net2.val_bc_mse, (.net2.seconds | floor), (.net2.final | to_entries | map("\(.key) \(.value | tostring | .[0:7])") | join(", "))] | join(" | ")' "$r") |"; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
